title: Collatz conjecture
summary: The open claim that every positive integer orbit under the Collatz map eventually reaches 1.

context.note: Framework is named textually in this seed release; full recursive first-principles closure remains future work.

assumptions.text: The Collatz map T is as defined in qeva:1:collatz-map@1.

content.plain: Every tested starting value appears eventually to enter the 1→4→2→1 cycle, but no proof is known for all positive integers.
content.exact: For every n∈N_{>0}, there exists k≥0 such that T^k(n)=1.
content.example: The orbit of 6 reaches 1 after eight steps if the starting value is counted as step 0.
content.caveat: This is open. Error-amplification, chaos, hierarchy, or emergent-invariance descriptions are research hypotheses unless made precise and proved.

relations.note: One may search for multiscale structure, but none is asserted here.
Sensitivity-like comparisons can be studied after specifying a metric/embedding; they do not resolve the conjecture by themselves.

verification.method: QEVA seed formulation checked editorially for mathematical coherence; no external formal proof artifact is claimed.

provenance.creator: QEVA seed archive
